email.subject1: a signal play for Zone & Co
email.body1:
Steven, saw Zone & Co launched Zoe's Agentic Control Layer, named a new COO, and made the 2025 Inc. 5000.

Growth at that pace usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so reps stop doing research and CRM work and spend time closing: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a signal play for Zone & Co off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Steven, quick follow-up for Zone & Co.

Inc. 5000 growth usually raises the pipeline bar faster than headcount can follow. Most orgs don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings Zone & Co needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Steven, last bit of proof for Zone & Co.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how Zone & Co's reply rate likely compares to peer high-growth SaaS. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Steven, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a CRO priority this quarter, no problem at all. A product launch plus a new COO makes for a busy stretch, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your revenue motion? I will tailor it to Zone & Co either way.
